title: UKB — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here. Special answers are taken from UK Biobank's own code lists and written per field; none is generated (D036).

yes_no.description: A plain Yes/No pair, same code and meaning everywhere it is used (e.g. UK Biobank encoding 7) (D024).

eid.title: Encoded participant identifier
eid.description: The application-specific encoded identifier for a UK Biobank participant. Not itself a Showcase field; added as the table's link key (D012).
eid.$comment: Typed as a positive integer on the evidence of record_column.txt, where every linked-record table's own eid column is declared value_type=11 (Integer).
